name: NONSOLUS
source:
In the shadowed province of Vokhomourne, you and your mentor detective must uncover the truth behind a series of grisly murders.

Here, the nation itself is peculiar, and the people you meet are far stranger than you could imagine.

[From [url=https://teamhomebound.itch.io/nonsolus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在阴暗的沃霍穆恩省，你和你的侦探导师必须揭开一系列可怕谋杀案背后的真相。

在这里，这个国家本身很奇特，你遇到的人比你想象的还要陌生。

[来自[url=https://teamhomebound.itch.io/nonsolus]Itch.io[/url]]
